test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) was established as a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) under which of the following Acts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Companies Act, 1956**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) was established in **October 2006** as a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV).
 
• It was created under the **Companies Act, 1956**, to develop, mobilize resources, and operate dedicated freight corridors in India.
 
• DFCCIL operates under the administrative control of the **Ministry of Railways**, Government of India.
 
• The primary objective of DFCCIL is to **decongest India’s railway network** and improve freight transportation efficiency.
 
• It is responsible for planning and executing the construction of **Eastern and Western Dedicated Freight Corridors**, among other freight projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC)**

 
 
• A Dedicated Freight Corridor is a high-capacity rail network exclusively for freight transportation.
 
• India’s Eastern DFC spans from Ludhiana in Punjab to Dankuni in West Bengal, while the Western DFC runs from Dadri in Uttar Pradesh to Jawaharlal Nehru Port in Maharashtra.
 
• These corridors aim to reduce logistics costs, promote economic growth, and enhance supply chain efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Companies Act, 1956**
 
 
• It was a comprehensive legislation governing the registration, regulation, and dissolution of companies in India.
 
• The Act focused on ensuring accountability, transparency, and fair practices in corporate governance.
 
• The Companies Act, 1956, has since been replaced by the **Companies Act, 2013**, but many organizations like DFCCIL were initially incorporated under the 1956 Act.
 
 
 
• **SPV (Special Purpose Vehicle)**
 
 
• An SPV is a legal entity created for a specific purpose, such as infrastructure development.
 
• It allows separate financial and operational management for distinct projects.
 
• DFCCIL was set up as an SPV to facilitate better management of freight corridor projects.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Railways**
 
 
• The Ministry of Railways oversees India’s railway network, including freight corridors.
 
• It works towards modernizing rail infrastructure and enhancing operational efficiency.
